OUR ROLE

A thoughtful place
to begin.

Clear information can make a personal decision feel less overwhelming.

This website is operated by Hymen.ca Inc.

Information with perspective.

hymen.ca is an independent information and enquiry resource for adults in Canada exploring hymenoplasty and related intimate procedures. It is not a medical clinic and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or a clinician’s assessment.

Your choice deserves context.

We explain terminology, link to source material, and encourage questions about evidence, costs, risks, and alternatives. We do not use patient testimonials, before-and-after images, or promises of a particular result.

Transparent about our role.

Provider links are based on public websites and do not imply a partnership. Consultation requests are sent to the hymen.ca form account through Formspree; listed providers are not automatically sent your details.

Our educational content is a sourced summary, not a medical review by our own clinical team.
